+re_title_paren = re.compile(r'^(.*) \([^)]+?\)$')

+
+def _normalize_edition_title(title: str) -> str:
+    normalized = merge.normalize(title).lower()
+    without_punctuation = ''.join(
+        ' ' if category(char).startswith(('P', 'S')) else char for char in normalized
+    )
+    return ' '.join(without_punctuation.split())
+
+
+def build_titles(title: str) -> dict[str, str | list[str]]:
+    """Create normalized and short title forms for edition comparison."""
+    normalized_title = _normalize_edition_title(title)
+    titles = [title, normalized_title]
+    prior_normalized_title = merge.normalize(title).lower()
+    if prior_normalized_title != normalized_title:
+        titles.append(prior_normalized_title)
+    if ' & ' in title:
+        with_and = title.replace(' & ', ' and ')
+        titles.extend((with_and, merge.normalize(with_and)))
+
+    without_article = []
+    for variation in titles:
+        if variation.lower().startswith('the '):
+            without_article.append(variation[4:])
+        elif variation.lower().startswith('a '):
+            without_article.append(variation[2:])
+    titles.extend(without_article)
+
+    if re_title_paren.match(title):
+        without_parentheses = []
+        for variation in titles:
+            if match := re_title_paren.match(variation):
+                without_parentheses.extend(
+                    (match.group(1), merge.normalize(match.group(1)))
+                )
+        titles.extend(without_parentheses)
+
+    return {
+        'full_title': title,
+        'normalized_title': normalized_title,
+        'titles': list(dict.fromkeys(titles)),
+        'short_title': normalized_title[:25],
+    }
+
+
+def expand_record(rec: dict) -> dict[str, str | list[str]]:
+    """Expand an edition record into the title and field forms used for matching.
+
+    ``rec`` must contain ``full_title``. ISBNs from all three supported fields
+    are combined in ``isbn``. Comparison fields are copied when present, except
+    placeholder publish country values.
+    """
+    expanded = build_titles(rec['full_title'])
+    isbns: list[str] = []
+    for field in ('isbn', 'isbn_10', 'isbn_13'):
+        isbns.extend(rec.get(field, []))
+    expanded['isbn'] = isbns
+    if 'publish_country' in rec and rec['publish_country'] not in ('   ', '|||'):
+        expanded['publish_country'] = rec['publish_country']
+    for field in (
+        'lccn',
+        'publishers',
+        'publish_date',
+        'number_of_pages',
+        'authors',
+        'contribs',
+    ):
+        if field in rec:
+            expanded[field] = rec[field]
+    return expanded
